sees: frame 1: A cartoon woman with blonde hair in a navy dress stands on the left of a gray room holding a small red wallet. Title text reads 'PAVE OVER A GAPING CRATER'. A narrow, tall red oval coin with a dollar sign floats in the middle-right above a shadow. Top labels: 'INSIGHT 02 / 08 - DEVELOPMENT' and 'WE WERE LIARS'.
frame 2: Same scene; the red dollar coin has grown larger and rotated more face-on, now wider. The woman and wall/lamp are unchanged.
frame 3: The red dollar coin is now very large and fully round, dominating the right side and partly covering the lamp. The woman is unchanged and smiling slightly.
changed: The red dollar coin grew from a narrow tilted oval into a large, full round coin (turning toward the viewer and scaling up). The woman stayed the same.
cause: unclear; apparently just an animation emphasizing the coin/money, with no visible interaction with the woman.
effect: Money becomes the dominant visual element; the woman holding a wallet looks on. No visible crater or paving is shown.
message: The narrator is saying that money is used to cover over (pave over) a deep underlying problem rather than fixing it.
wouldConfuse: The title mentions a crater and paving, but nothing of the sort is shown; the woman smiles calmly while the giant coin grows, so the metaphor's link to the visuals is unclear. The relation between the woman, her wallet and the coin is not explained.
